reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE e.event_type = 'new'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
alternatives:
WITH new_events AS (
  -- one row per new event in 2025, in euros
  SELECT e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'new'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, ROUND(SUM(mrr_eur), 2) AS new_mrr
FROM new_events
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'new'), 2) AS new_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE e.event_type <> 'opening'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'new') > 0
